internalBreakdown.component: Practical file (15 Pandas, 4 Matplotlib programs, 15 SQL queries)

units.name: Data Handling using Pandas and Data Visualisation

chapters.name: Data Handling using Pandas
topics: Python libraries: Pandas, Matplotlib; Series and DataFrames
Series: creation from ndarray, dictionary, scalar; mathematical operations; head and tail; selection, indexing, slicing
DataFrames: creation from dictionary of Series, list of dictionaries, text/CSV files; iteration
Operations on rows and columns: add, select, delete, rename; label and Boolean indexing
Importing and exporting data between CSV files and DataFrames
outcomes: Create Series and DataFrames and apply operations

chapters.name: Data Visualisation
topics: Purpose of plotting
Line plot, bar graph, histogram with Matplotlib; saving plots
Customising: label, title, legend

chapters.name: Database Query using SQL
topics: Revision of Class XI database concepts and SQL
Math functions: POWER, ROUND, MOD
Text functions: UCASE/UPPER, LCASE/LOWER, MID/SUBSTRING/SUBSTR, LENGTH, LEFT, RIGHT, INSTR, LTRIM, RTRIM, TRIM
Date functions: NOW, DATE, MONTH, MONTHNAME, YEAR, DAY, DAYNAME
Aggregate functions MAX, MIN, AVG, SUM, COUNT, COUNT(*); GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY
Equi-join on two tables
outcomes: Design SQL queries using aggregate functions
Import and export data between an SQL database and Pandas

chapters.name: Introduction to Computer Networks
topics: PAN, LAN, MAN, WAN
Devices: modem, hub, switch, repeater, router, gateway
Topologies: star, bus, tree, mesh
Internet, URL, WWW; web, email, chat, VoIP
Website vs webpage; static vs dynamic pages; web server and hosting
Web browsers: settings, add-ons and plug-ins, cookies
outcomes: Identify internet security issues and configure browser settings

chapters.name: Societal Impacts
topics: Digital footprint; net and communication etiquettes
Data protection, IPR, plagiarism, licensing and copyright, FOSS
Cybercrime and cyber laws: hacking, phishing, cyber bullying; Indian IT Act
E-waste: hazards and management
Health concerns related to technology use
outcomes: Understand the impact of technology on society, including gender and disability issues
